_comment: Config for the headroom folder extension. Missing or broken file -> built-in defaults, same behavior.
Provider upstreams come straight from ../../models.json (pi's own manifest) - no copies here.
This map only carries per-provider overrides: enabled (default: true, except built-in defaults),
baseUrl override, shim override (default: automatic - providers whose chat path does not end in /v1
route through the in-process path shim at 127.0.0.1:8790, falling back to the next five
ports when busy, so several pi sessions can run side by side).
freetoken: disabled - loopback upstream rejected by Headroom's SSRF guard; no compression value.
nube: disabled - upstream resets proxied requests (E2E 2026-09-26).
extraEnv feeds the proxy process. SSL_CERT_FILE et al. point at the exported Windows root bundle
